posts.author: lobaz
posts.post_subject: where to find lasers for holography
posts.content_md:
> **thycore:** I found my red laser on eBay with keywords : "melles griot", it's a famous "brand" of lab laser & equipements, it's a good starting point.

Melles Griot sells many types of lasers. Not all of them are suitable for holography. Which takes us back to the beginning: if you are not a laser expert, buy it from someone who is (such as Phil "142laser" Bergeron).

posts.content_md:
Just an FYI incase nowhere else on forum - if duplicated sincere apologies, brand new to this group.

If you buy a color kit from them (litiholo) they include tem00 red, green & blue diode lasers...$349 

[http://www.litiholo.com/hologram_kits_color.html](http://www.litiholo.com/hologram_kits_color.html)

regardless of what you think of the "toy kit" it does actually work & the lasers work too, just not very powerful (~4-5mW?) not sure
